name: Commerce Eurobank
description: Off-site Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Eurobank (Modirum vPOS) with SHA-256 digest-verified callbacks.
project_description:
Redirection payment for Drupal Commerce and Eurobank (Greece).

By using redirection payments your clients get redirect to the bank and fill in their credit card data there. No information is stored at the Drupal side. This ensures security and it costs less because there is no need for certificates on your server.

 Status & Development 
 Eurobank doesn't accept test credit-cards like other banks do.

 Credits 
 Originally developed for Drupal 7 by Xaris Tsimpouris and Bill Seremetis and sponsored by SRM .

Drupal 8 version is developed by Pelagus Creative Web , authored by Konstantinos Skarlatos ( https://www.drupal.org/user/1869414/ ) and Stamatis Giannakis and is based on Drupal 8 version of https://www.drupal.org/project/commerce_winbank_redirect created by GiorgosK 

 The developers can create modules for other banks on demand. 

This can be done for any bank that uses the redirection method, either greek banks or from other countries.
